verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a mobile Git client, so managing coding work from a phone is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can launch, monitor, or track tasks run by cloud-based coding agents. The documented Repository Agent is a conversational in-app assistant that browses, edits, commits, pulls and pushes within a repository. It is not described as a dashboard for remote agent tasks, so it does not deliver this story.
